title: Global Meet-Up #7 (Toronto):  The Rupture
summary: On Friday, October 9, 2026, Professor Jiang delivered a lecture to his Substack Founding Members in Toronto.  He argued that current global crises (including the war in the Middle East, the rightward shift in South America, and the US-Canada trade war) can be best explained as by-products of a struggle between the Tech Bros and central bankers to control the nature of reality.
